theme.title: Quiet Session
theme.summary: Utilities (+0.12%) and Consumer Discretionary (+0.08%) led the market today, while Technology (-0.52%) and Industrials (-0.37%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.15%, defensives -0.05%, and value/cyclicals -0.08% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.21%, Dow +0.22%, Nasdaq +0.16% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.50%. The VIX rose 7.12% to 15.95, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.92% to $4,513.70, crude oil was little changed at $87.47, and bitcoin gained 3.47% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
